annotation.evidence_span: MUST carry an application error code
annotation.interpretation_a: The application providing the data for the stream MUST define the error code.
annotation.interpretation_b: The QUIC implementation MUST define a set of standard application error codes that are used in RST_STREAM frames.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'application error code' is incomplete. It does not specify *which* application defines the error code. This leaves open the possibility of multiple interpretations regarding the source and meaning of the error code.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the 'application error code' is defined by the application using the stream, or by the QUIC implementation itself. This affects how the error code is generated and interpreted.
